Edgewood Treatment Centre offers a wide range of programs that cater to the diverse needs of their patients. These programs are designed to provide comprehensive care and support to individuals struggling with addiction, trauma, and psychological injury. They understand that every patient is unique, which is why they offer a personalized approach to each program that they offer.

Detox Program

Edgewood’s detox program provides medically supervised services for patients who are experiencing physical withdrawal symptoms associated with substance abuse. They have licensed medical professionals who are available 24/7 to ensure the patient’s comfort and safety throughout the detoxification process. Their detox program provides a stable and supportive environment and provides patients with the first step towards a successful recovery.

Inpatient Care

Edgewood’s inpatient program provides intensive residential treatment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their inpatient care programs are designed to provide an immersive experience that fosters healing, growth, and recovery. Their innovative and holistic approach integrates a range of evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavioral therapy, and trauma therapy.

Extended Care

Edgewood’s extended care program provides ongoing treatment and support for patients transitioning from inpatient care. This program is designed to help patients maintain their sobriety and continue to build positive relationships and connections with others in recovery. Edgewood provides a safe and supportive space that provides patients with resources and community to work through life’s challenges as they continue on their recovery journey.

Family Programs

At Edgewood Treatment Centre, family involvement is a crucial aspect of their treatment programs. Edgewood recognizes that addiction does not only affect the individual but also impacts the family unit as a whole. Their Family Program provides a safe, supportive space for families to learn and understand addiction and ways they can support their loved ones recover in sobriety.

Trauma & Addiction

Edgewood’s trauma and addiction program is designed to address the complex relationship between trauma and addiction. Their program provides individuals struggling with substance use disorder the opportunity to access specialized trauma-informed care that helps them work through their addiction, regulate their feelings, and improve their overall well-being.

Sex Addictions

Sex addiction is a complex disorder that is often misunderstood. Edgewood’s Sexual Addiction program provides specialized treatment and care for individuals struggling with sex addiction. Their program offers a safe and confidential environment that focuses on healing, recovery, and understanding about this addiction.

Trauma & Psychological Injury

Edgewood’s Trauma and Psychological Injury program is designed to help individuals who have experienced a traumatic experience gain insight and help them understand how their trauma has impacted their lives. Their program provides specialized care to help individuals work through the trauma that often leads to addiction.

LGBTQ+

Edgewood recognizes that members of the LGBTQ+ community face unique challenges when it comes to seeking addiction treatment. That’s why their programs are designed to be inclusive and sensitive to the unique needs and experiences of this community, by providing a supportive and affirmative environment.

Edgewood Treatment Centre- Center Overview

Our network of recovery centres offers top-notch mental health care services catering to our patients’ needs. We cover a wide range of treatment programs, including outpatient therapy, detox stays, and multi-month treatment for individuals with substance use disorders and other mental health conditions. At our rehab centre, we focus on providing personalized, evidence-based care that takes into account each patient’s unique challenges.

Our approach to mental health and substance use disorder treatment is centered on medical excellence and scientific research. We have a team of licensed medical professionals, including psychiatrists, skilled nurses, addiction-certified doctors, and occupational therapists, who are involved in every step of our patients’ recovery journey. Through our licensed hospitals and accredited facilities, we offer a safe, inclusive, and comfortable environment for recovery. Edgewood Treatment Centre offers a wide range of programs that cater to the diverse needs of their patients. These programs are designed to provide comprehensive care and support to individuals struggling with addiction, trauma, and psychological injury. They understand that every patient is unique, which is why they offer a personalized approach to each program that they offer.

Detox Program

Edgewood’s detox program provides medically supervised services for patients who are experiencing physical withdrawal symptoms associated with substance abuse. They have licensed medical professionals who are available 24/7 to ensure the patient’s comfort and safety throughout the detoxification process. Their detox program provides a stable and supportive environment and provides patients with the first step towards a successful recovery.

Inpatient Care

Edgewood’s inpatient program provides intensive residential treatment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their inpatient care programs are designed to provide an immersive experience that fosters healing, growth, and recovery. Their innovative and holistic approach integrates a range of evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavioral therapy, and trauma therapy.

Extended Care

Edgewood’s extended care program provides ongoing treatment and support for patients transitioning from inpatient care. This program is designed to help patients maintain their sobriety and continue to build positive relationships and connections with others in recovery. Edgewood provides a safe and supportive space that provides patients with resources and community to work through life’s challenges as they continue on their recovery journey.

Family Programs

At Edgewood Treatment Centre, family involvement is a crucial aspect of their treatment programs. Edgewood recognizes that addiction does not only affect the individual but also impacts the family unit as a whole. Their Family Program provides a safe, supportive space for families to learn and understand addiction and ways they can support their loved ones recover in sobriety.

Trauma & Addiction

Edgewood’s trauma and addiction program is designed to address the complex relationship between trauma and addiction. Their program provides individuals struggling with substance use disorder the opportunity to access specialized trauma-informed care that helps them work through their addiction, regulate their feelings, and improve their overall well-being.

Sex Addictions

Sex addiction is a complex disorder that is often misunderstood. Edgewood’s Sexual Addiction program provides specialized treatment and care for individuals struggling with sex addiction. Their program offers a safe and confidential environment that focuses on healing, recovery, and understanding about this addiction.

Trauma & Psychological Injury

Edgewood’s Trauma and Psychological Injury program is designed to help individuals who have experienced a traumatic experience gain insight and help them understand how their trauma has impacted their lives. Their program provides specialized care to help individuals work through the trauma that often leads to addiction.

LGBTQ+

Edgewood recognizes that members of the LGBTQ+ community face unique challenges when it comes to seeking addiction treatment. That’s why their programs are designed to be inclusive and sensitive to the unique needs and experiences of this community, by providing a supportive and affirmative environment.

Edgewood Treatment Centre- Center Overview

Our network of recovery centres offers top-notch mental health care services catering to our patients’ needs. We cover a wide range of treatment programs, including outpatient therapy, detox stays, and multi-month treatment for individuals with substance use disorders and other mental health conditions. At our rehab centre, we focus on providing personalized, evidence-based care that takes into account each patient’s unique challenges.

Our approach to mental health and substance use disorder treatment is centered on medical excellence and scientific research. We have a team of licensed medical professionals, including psychiatrists, skilled nurses, addiction-certified doctors, and occupational therapists, who are involved in every step of our patients’ recovery journey. Through our licensed hospitals and accredited facilities, we offer a safe, inclusive, and comfortable environment for recovery. Our vision is to promote destigmatized, flexible, and accessible mental health care services with no wait times, accessible nationwide, and on par with treatment for other conditions.

In carrying out our mission, we strive to provide full-spectrum care to achieve positive outcomes, delivered by medical experts motivated by compassion and courage. We are committed to helping our patients tackle the root causes of their concerns through evidence-based care. We aim to support families in the healing process and the public care system at large. Our core values, including exceptional medical care, courage, and compassion, underpin our rehabilitation centre’s culture, and we continue to work towards improving the mental and emotional well-being of all those who seek our services.
